moaSummary.value: Stimulates alpha and beta adrenergic receptors — used in anaphylaxis and selected resuscitation contexts. Educational framing only; confirm against current SA STG/EML and labelled product. Materia does not invent a dose or dilution.
Competitive muscarinic receptor antagonist — educational framing for bradycardia and cholinergic contexts. Materia does not invent a dose or indication algorithm.
Competitive opioid receptor antagonist used to reverse opioid-induced respiratory depression — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a dose, route ladder, or observation interval.
Replenishes glutathione pathways relevant to paracetamol poisoning management — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a weight-based regimen or nomogram threshold.
Adsorbent used in selected overdose contexts to reduce absorption of some toxins — educational framing only. Not for all poisons; Materia does not invent timing windows or gram doses.
Parenteral calcium salt used in selected electrolyte and toxicity contexts — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a dose, infusion rate, or ECG-triggered algorithm.
Magnesium salt used in obstetric eclampsia pathways and selected other labelled contexts — educational framing only. Materia does not invent a loading dose, maintenance rate, or monitoring target.
